metadata.question: Did the town of Marovoay have higher water extent in January 27, 2020 than January 18, 2017?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about comparing water extent between two specific dates in Marovoay, Madagascar. I need to: 1. Find Marovoay coordinates (approximately -16.11, 46.64) 2. Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery for the specific dates 3. Calculate water extent using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) 4. Compare the water extent between the two dates For water detection, I'll use NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR). Values > 0 typically indicate water. I'll use Sentinel-2 because it has good temporal resolution and the specific dates requested. I need to: - Define the location (point with buffer around Marovoay) - Get Sentinel-2 images for the exact dates - Apply cloud masking - Calculate NDWI and count water pixels - Compare the counts between the two dates I should check for empty collections and valid pixel counts as per the requirements. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const marovoay = ee.Geometry.Point([46.644, -16.111]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Marovoay // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for specific dates const date1 = '2017-01-18'; const date2 = '2020-01-27'; // Function to get and process Sentinel-2 image function getWaterExtent(date) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(marovoay) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) return {count: null, pixels: null, images: 0}; const image = collection.first(); // Cloud masking using QA60 band const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); const maskedImage = image.updateMask(mask); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = maskedImage.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water pixels (NDWI > 0.1) const water = ndwi.gt(0.1); // Count water pixels const waterCount = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: marovoay, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Count total valid pixels for validation const pixelCount = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: marovoay, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); return {count: waterCount, pixels: pixelCount, images: size}; } // Process both dates const result2017 = getWaterExtent(date1); const result2020 = getWaterExtent(date2); // Print evidence console.log(`2017-01-18: Images=${result2017.images}, WaterPixels=${result2017.count}, ValidPixels=${result2017.pixels}`); console.log(`2020-01-27: Images=${result2020.images}, WaterPixels=${result2020.count}, ValidPixels=${result2020.pixels}`); // Check for empty collections if (result2017.images === 0 || result2020.images === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Check for no valid pixels if (result2017.pixels === 0 || result2020.pixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (result2017.count === null || result2020.count === null || isNaN(result2017.count) || isNaN(result2020.count)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare water extent and provide answer if (result2020.count > result2017.count) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
